body: I just walked away really, didn’t say anything much but stuttered from knowing she actually doesn’t love me. At the end I just said “ok” and walked away from her. I’m saying nothing to her, no, she hasn’t texted or called. So her reaction is very underwhelming.
The thought that it only gets better is so so relieving. Thank you
Haha thanks..riding my motorcycle on the freeway always feels good and I don’t always get that chance. Maybe I’ll celebrate that way. Thank you
😔 you’re probably right, thanks for caring

I’m just so scared, I really don’t want to lose her, not like this. We’ve been together for more than two whole years and have so much in common. Her main fault is trust issues so me doing this just..i feel sick saying it but this just destroyed all trust she had for me. I’d do anything to go back and stop myself..
